jobs.title: Founders Associate - Operations
jobs.description:
Heidi Systems baut das Energy-OS für Real Estate. Dafür digitalisieren wir einen der letzten großen analogen Märkte Europas und schaffen die Infrastruktur für intelligentes Energiemanagement in Gebäuden.

Wo wir stehen

8 Personen

Starke Pipeline mit +5.000 aktiven Deals

Angel-Runde mit Unicorn-Foundern sowie Directors von Google und OpenAI

Auf dem Weg zu 10x in 2026

Wir rollen die Messdienstbranche neu auf – einen riesigen, verstaubten Markt, den seit Jahrzehnten kaum jemand angefasst hat. Als Prop- und ClimateTech verbinden wir Software, IoT und Operations zu einer Plattform, die Energie- und Verbrauchsdaten erstmals durchgängig digital, transparent und in Echtzeit verfügbar macht.

Wir wachsen stark und suchen jemanden, der unsere operativen Abläufe mit aufbaut, übernimmt und kontinuierlich besser macht.

Als Operations Manager bist du für die  End-to-End-Umsetzung unserer Kundenprojekte  verantwortlich. Aus einem gewonnenen Auftrag machst du ein erfolgreich umgesetztes Projekt.

Du koordinierst Kunden, Hausverwaltungen, Eigentümer, Installateure und weitere Partner, hältst Projekte auf Kurs und sorgst dafür, dass Probleme gelöst werden, bevor sie eskalieren.

Gleichzeitig baust du gemeinsam mit unserem Founder die operativen Strukturen von Heidi Systems weiter aus.

Die Rolle ist bewusst breit angelegt:  Du bekommst kein fertiges Playbook. Du baust es mit auf.

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst  End-to-End Ownership  für eigene Kunden und Objekte – vom Onboarding bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung und laufenden Betreuung

Du koordinierst Hausverwaltungen, Eigentümer, Installateure, Mieter und weitere Partner und stellst sicher, dass alle Beteiligten zur richtigen Zeit die richtigen Informationen haben

Du steuerst viele Projekte parallel und behältst eigenständig den Überblick, ohne, dass jemand dir hinterlaufen muss

Du bist zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden und Partner und kommunizierst schnell, klar und verbindlich

Du löst operative Probleme eigenständig. Wenn etwas nicht funktioniert, suchst du nach einer Lösung, bis es klappt und schreckst auch nicht vor unkonventionellen Methoden zurück

Du identifizierst manuelle, fehleranfällige oder repetitive Prozesse und entwickelst daraus skalierbare Prozesse und Systeme

Du automatisierst operative Abläufe mit No-Code-/Low-Code- und AI-Tools, z. B. n8n, Claude Code oder vergleichbaren Tools

Du baust Strukturen für Projekttracking, Dokumentation, Reporting und interne Kommunikation auf und stellst sicher, dass diese im Alltag funktionieren

Du analysierst operative Kennzahlen, erkennst Engpässe und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab

Du übernimmst eigene Projekte und Initiativen von der Problemdefinition über die Umsetzung bis zur Erfolgsmessung

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Founder zusammen und übernimmst mit wachsendem Vertrauen zunehmend größere operative Verantwortungsbereiche.

Qualifikation

Wir suchen jemanden mit  hohem Drive, starkem analytischem Denken und Lust darauf, früh Veran

jobs.description:

Your mission

GENUINE Beauty is a dynamic, fast-growing social commerce agency based in Cologne. We help international brands succeed on TikTok Shop and grow sustainably through innovative marketing strategies, creator partnerships and data-driven shop management.

We love creative ideas, fast decisions and people who want to make things happen.

Your responsibilities

TikTok Shop Management:  Support our team with the day-to-day running and optimization of TikTok Shops.

Creator Management:  Help research, identify and reach out to the right content creators and influencers.

Your profile

jobs.title: Chief of Staff - Operations
jobs.description:
Über Ralph  Ralph baut das Operating System für Wohnimmobilien. Der Markt ist riesig, und er läuft noch größtenteils auf Aktenordnern, Outlook und USB-Sticks. Wir sind der erste AI Property Manager, der auf einem eigenen Operating System läuft, und betreiben Gebäude damit End-to-End. Ralph OS automatisiert Zahlungen, Buchhaltung, Compliance und Kommunikation. AI-Agenten bereiten die Arbeit vor, und unser Team gibt sie frei. Die Hausverwaltung ist unser Einstieg. Das Ziel ist die neue Infrastruktur für die ganze Kategorie, mit Fintech, Versicherung und Finanzierung auf derselben Plattform. Heute verwalten wir über 10.000 Wohneinheiten und wachsen schnell, organisch und durch Zukäufe. Verantwortung bekommst du bei uns früh, und was du baust, nutzen wir direkt im Alltag.  Warum das wichtig ist  Die Verwaltung rund ums Zuhause ist oft frustrierend. Ralph macht Wohnen einfacher, effizienter und wirklich digital – ein echtes „Home in your Pocket“.  Aufgaben

Integration & Transformation:  Du arbeitest eng mit dem VP Operations daran, neu erworbene Unternehmen sauber zu integrieren und operativ auf Ralph-Standard zu bringen.

Process Design:  Du entwickelst Playbooks, Standards, Eskalationslogiken und Entscheidungsroutinen für wiederkehrende operative Situationen.

Automation:  Du identifizierst manuelle, fehleranfällige Abläufe und arbeitest mit Product, Tech und Operations an besseren, automatisierten Lösungen.

People & Change:  Du begleitest neue Arbeitsweisen, schärfst Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten und stellst sicher, dass Veränderungen im Team wirklich ankommen.

Execution:  Du übernimmst wichtige Transformationsprojekte mit direktem Einfluss auf Effizienz, Qualität und Kundenzufriedenheit.

Escalation Management:  Du springst bei komplexen operativen Themen ein, strukturierst Sachverhalte und übersetzt sie in konkrete nächste Schritte.

Fixer:  Dir ist kein Problem zu groß oder zu klein – du übernimmst Ownership und bleibst dran, bis das Problem kein Problem mehr ist.

Qualifikation

Entrepreneurial Spirit:  Du willst verstehen, wie man ein Unternehmen operativ besser macht, und hast keine Berührungsängste, selbst hands-on einzusteigen.

Change Mindset:  Du verstehst, dass gute Prozesse nicht nur gebaut, sondern erklärt, eingeführt und im Alltag verankert werden müssen.

Analytische Schärfe:  Du liebst Daten und komplexe Zusammenhänge, kannst sie aber in einfache, umsetzbare Prozesse übersetzen.

Execution Power:  Du hast einen extremen Drang zum Machen. Wenn du eine Mauer siehst, suchst du nicht nach dem Grund, sondern nach dem Weg darüber hinweg.

Kommunikation:  Du bist rhetorisch stark, kannst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen souverän auftreten und sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau.

Benefits

Sparring:  Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem VP Operations zusammen und bekommst tiefen Einblick in zentrale Management-, Integrations- und Transformationsfragen. Hoher Exposure zum Rest des Executive Leadership Teams.

Impact:  Deine Arbeit beeinflusst

Das Team  Du arbeitest direkt mit unseren Gründern sowie unserem Plattform- und Delivery-Team aus AI und Software Engineering zusammen. Die Infrastruktur unserer Produkte entsteht im engen Austausch mit den Engineers, die darauf entwickeln – kurze Wege und direkte Abstimmung sind dabei selbstverständlich.  Qualifikation  Must-haves

Du bist immatrikulierte/r Student/in im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.

Du hast schon  Server selbst aufgesetzt und betrieben  und weißt, wie man sie absichert, überwacht und bei Problemen debuggt – ob im Homelab, im Studium oder im Job

Verständnis und erste Erfahrungen mit  Container-Plattformen  wie Kubernetes, OpenShift oder vergleichbaren Systemen

Kenntnisse von  Cloud-Infrastruktur  und ihren Konzepten

Sicherer Umgang mit  Git

Eigenständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen

Interesse an IT-Sicherheit und regulierten Umgebungen

Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Engineers und daran, technische Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar zu begründen

Deutsch verhandlungssicher

Für uns zählen  praktische Erfahrungen mehr als Zertifikate . Homelab, eigene Server, Open-Source-Beiträge oder GitHub-Repositories sehen wir uns deshalb besonders gerne an.  Nice-to-have

Erfahrung mit  KI- und GenAI-Tooling , z. B. LLM-APIs, Agenten-Frameworks oder dem Betrieb von Mode

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Containers
jobs.description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell

Chainguard Containers is our core product, and this team builds it. As a Senior Software Engineer in Container Product Engineering you will design and ship the features, services, and build systems behind Chainguard Containers, working in a small sub-team of two to four engineers that owns one project end to end.

Chainguard is growing explosively. Every line of code is now written with AI in the loop, which means the foundation it runs on has to be secure by default. You will build that foundation: the hardened container images, the registry that serves them, and the tooling that lets engineers and AI agents adopt them.

This is a product role. You will work directly with Product Managers and customers, make the trade-off calls on the features you own, and ship them.

What the team owns

  • Product features for Chainguard Containers. Letting customers push their own images to our registry, Custom Assembly (customers compose images from our hardened packages), Helm charts, notifications, and compliance views such as STIG dashboards (STIG is the US government's hardening standard).
  • The image build pipeline. The systems that turn packages from Wolfi, our Linux distribution, into signed and attested container images at scale, including moving image builds onto our own runner infrastructure.
  • Registry performance and distribution. Work such as lazy loading, so a container starts before its whole image has downloaded, and image signing with Sigstore.
  • Adoption tooling for engineers and AI agents. Migration tools that convert existing Dockerfiles to Chainguard Containers, and MCP servers (Model Context Protocol, the standard that lets AI agents call tools) so agents can discover and pull our images directly.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and ship new features and services for Chainguard Containers, from a one-page design through production and the first week of customer use.
  • Own the trade-offs on your work: scope, sequencing, what to cut, and when "good enough to ship" beats "complete". Say so clearly when a plan is at risk.
  • Work with AI codin

jobs.description:
This is a permanent full-time remote opportunity for those based in the UK.

About Nearform

Nearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart.

As part of our Engineering function, you will work closely with clients to translate complex business requirements into innovative digital products.

Whether you are a Senior Engineer, Tech Lead, or DevOps Engineer, you will collaborate with distributed teams, leveraging cutting-edge technologies to build secure, high-performance applications. Our Nearform engineers are known for building high quality, scalable solutions that solve real world problems.

About the Senior Golang Engineer role

As a Senior Engineer at Nearform your main task will be designing & building applications using Golang. However as you’ll likely work on a variety of projects your responsibilities may also include:

  • Supporting component design, development and maintenance and taking responsibility for personal technical quality standards within the project team.
  • Assisting with defining structured practices, especially in source code management, building and deployment.
  • Designing and implementing data storage solutions.
  • Optimising performance in applications for maximum speed and scalability.
  • Getting feedback from users and clients, and building solutions for them.
  • Assisting with the analysis of client requirements.
  • Working with and supporting Technical Leaders in project execution and timely delivery.
  • Collaborating with client teams.

What we are looking for in this person

  • Significant experience delivering at a Senior Engineer level. Our Seniors typically have at least 6 years’ commercial experience.
  • Practical experience of delivering in an agile environment.
  • Practical experience and knowledge of developing real-world solutions.
  • Deep knowledge of Golang.
  • Working on K8s is essential.
  • Python experience is highly desirable.
  • Deep understanding of versioning control tools - e.g. Git.
  • Testing experience and familiarity

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Strategist
jobs.description:
About Nearform

Nearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart.

We're on a mission to reinvent how our clients work

Most companies are bolting AI onto old processes and hoping for the best. We think that's the wrong way round.

Nearform is on an exciting journey with AI, and we're building a new team to lead it. The team brings together two worlds that rarely meet: the business thinking of a strategy firm and the engineering depth of a company that builds and ships real products. That puts us in a small group of firms that can do both. We work out what should change and we build it.

The Role

Our clients don't all start in the same place. Some know something has to change but have no idea where to start. Others have a clear picture of the future and are ready to build. Most are somewhere in between.

Your job is to work out where each client really is and shape the right solution for them. That could mean helping a leadership team choose which process to tackle first. It could also mean turning a rough idea into something our engineers can build.

This isn't a traditional management consulting role

You won't be writing a strategy deck that sits on a shelf. This is hands-on work, close to the technology, and focused on results you can see.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Get on the ground. Sit with the teams doing the work, whether they're checking customers against sanctions lists or pulling together month-end reports. Learn how it really happens, including the workarounds, the judgement calls and the steps nobody wrote down.
  • Spot the opportunity. Find where AI and automation can change the game, and where a person still needs to make the call.
  • Design what comes next. Work side by side with a forward deployed engineer to shape a better way of working, testing ideas against what can actually be built.
  • Prove the value. Own the business case for each process you redesign. Work out where the value is,

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Subscription Performance
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the team

The Subscription Strategy & Performance team sets the strategic direction and performance bar for Wolt+ and Deliveroo Plus across EMEA. We sit within Subscription EMEA, whose vision is to build the best local-commerce membership programme in the region. The Strategy & Performance team owns the subscription strategy, planning rhythm, and performance, turning subscriber data into priorities, investment choices, and leadership-aligned strategies that other teams can act on. We work closely with other subscription teams and market teams.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Associate to to own strategic projects and lead analyses that help define the strategy & goals for the team. You’ll partner closely with other subscription team members and local market teams to identify opportunities, align priorities and execute initiatives. You'll be expected to move fluidly between deep-dives, planning inputs, and stakeholder communication, and to be a trusted subscription counterparty on cross-functional projects. Success means you become the trusted counterparty for subscription related topics, leadership trusts your outputs, and your work helps to guide our priorities.

Typical problems you'll own

  • Where is subscription performance ahead or behind ambitions, what are the drivers and what interventions should we drive?
  • How do we ensure we stay competitive and build a top class membership product across markets?
  • What do customers value and how should we improve our product to be closer to our vision of a leading EMEA local-commerce membership programme?

What you’ll be doing

  • Identifying opportunities to improve subscription program performance across markets by analyzing gaps, doing opportunity sizing
  • Building recommendations on levers to pull & product features to build to boost growth, improve profitability and build a winning subscription program
  • Translating findings and recommendations into leadership communication

As a Prediction Model Expert, you bring deep expertise in AI forecasting, software development in Python, backed by a dissertation on prediction models or time series forecasting. You have hands-on experience with foundation models for forecasting, multi-modal prediction frameworks (can be across disciplines like medicine), cloud environments. You will be one of Haste's first senior AI researchers pioneering prediction models that anticipate stealthy threats across HPC clusters, AI and quantum workloads before they strike.

Key Responsibilities

Predictive Model Development & Engineering:  Designing, building, and deploying Machine Learning (ML) and Foundation models to forecast potential security breaches.

Anomaly Detection & Behavior Analysis:  Establishing "normal" baselines and flagging deviations that indicate malicious behaviour together with our security experts and research teams.

Model Optimization & Maintenance:  Continuously refining algorithms, hyperparameter tuning, and adapting models to combat "model drift" as attacker tactics evolve.

Collaboration & Communication:  Translating complex mathematical models into actionable insights, and producing research reports, white papers, or conference presentations.

Why Join Haste?

If you’ve ever wanted to build the world’s fastest threat detection and hunting platform for the future of compute, this is the place for you. If you want to build technology that pushes the boundaries of cybersecurity for HPC, AI, and quantum environments, this is where you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career.

From detecting AI model poisoning mid-training to hunting quantum side-channel leaks and nation-state IP theft in HPC clusters. Haste mirrors the complexity of high-stakes compute infrastructure—HPC supercomputers, trillion-parameter AI workloads, quantum computers, and enterprise infrastructure—letting security teams detect, hunt, and analyze only relevant threats lightning fast.

We are a EU funded, fast-growing cybersecurity startup securing compute for governments, research labs, and Fortune 500 enterprises. Our mission is to secure every compute-intensive workload from AI training to quantum simulations—revolutionizing cyber defense.

StellDirVor is an independent consulting, trade and technology company specializing in immersive technologies for healthcare. We support organizations in implementing digital innovations — Virtual, Augmented and Mixed Reality as well as AI — particularly for learning, training and real-time assistance in clinical and care environments. By combining technology and healthcare, we help optimize processes, improve knowledge transfer and enhance quality of care. jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (Data Integrations)
jobs.description:
Orcrist is building a next generation data intelligence platform using cutting-edge technologies. We're handling petabyte-scale data with sub-second queries. Our product is a Kubernetes‑based platform delivered as B2B SaaS or as a self‑hosted on‑prem solution, including air‑gapped deployments. We enable customers across defense, law enforcement, and enterprise to turn mission-critical data into actionable intelligence.

Role

Every investigation starts with data. As PM for the Integration team, you make sure analysts in law enforcement and defense have the data they need, when they need it. You own the roadmap for integrating data from commercial vendors, open feeds, social media and messaging platforms, as well as the admin interfaces used to manage these integrations. Your work ensures data arrives current, traceable to its source and ready to use.

This is a largely technical PM role with significant ownership over a platform and admin experience that are still taking shape. You decide what gets built and in what order, working closely with engineers and other product teams to turn provider APIs and data models into scalable integrations and features that support analysts’ investigations. You’ll read API documentation, map provider data to OIP’s data model and write clear, actionable specs that engineers can build from.

What you'll do

  • Own the provider roadmap. We add a source when it answers a question analysts can’t answer today, so you start from the analyst’s problem, not from a provider’s name. You talk regularly with analysts, admins and solutions engineers in law enforcement and defense, and with the upstream teams whose features bring integration requests. You decide which providers come next and what “done” means for each.
  • Write the technical specs. Cover authentication, pagination, rate limits and quotas, incremental sync, deduplication, field mapping, and how failures surface. Every object must carry its provider, fetch time and source URL from the moment it is fetched. Our platform runs as SaaS and on-prem, so you also decide how each source behaves in each distribution.
  • Own the connectors as a product. That covers the contract between connectors and the platform, versioning, and how quickly a new provider goes from evaluation to production. Every connector should make the next one cheaper. Where another team can reach a public source on its own, you give it a safe way to do so instead of putting it in our queue.
  • Own the admin interfaces. That means creating a connection, managing credentials, scheduling, health and status, logs, quota usage and permissions. A source we can’t monitor isn’t delivered, so every live connection needs a health check and clear failure states.

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer, FPGA
jobs.description:
Normal Computing | Build with Us

Normal is an applied AI company solving the hardest problems in AI and silicon. We build foundational hardware and software for the semiconductor industry, critical AI infrastructure, and the broader systems that power our world, in partnership with the world's most advanced institutions. We work as one team across New York City, Silicon Valley (Mountain View), and London.

The Role

Validating conventional silicon is a solved discipline. Validating silicon that computes with noise is not, and you will be the one who figures out how. As our FPGA Design Engineer, you will own the bridge between RTL and physical silicon: bringing our physics-inspired ASIC designs to life on FPGA platforms for pre-silicon validation and early software development, and building the test infrastructure for post-silicon bring-up and characterization. Your scope spans the entire FPGA lifecycle: selecting hardware platforms, implementing complex RTL, debugging in the lab, and writing the software that drives it all, working daily with our silicon, EDA, and research teams.

What You Will Own

FPGA Platform Ownership : Lead the selection, procurement, and bring-up of FPGA prototyping platforms (e.g., HAPS, VCU118/VPK180-class boards, or custom hardware) for pre-silicon RTL validation and software development.

RTL Implementation : Adapt and implement complex ASIC RTL onto FPGA targets, including multi-clock-domain architectures, CDC bridges, and timing closure on dense designs.

IP Integration : Integrate in-house designs with third-party and vendor IP; serve as the expert on the AMD/Xilinx ecosystem (Vivado IP Integrator, transceivers, memory controllers).

High-Speed Interfaces : Design, implement, and validate high-speed I/O with a focus on PCIe: our accelerators ship as PCIe cards in standard servers.

Post-Silicon Validation : Build FPGA-based "tester" designs for silicon bring-up, device characterization, and automated test environments.

Hardware-Software Stack : Develop the software layer around the hardware: Python/C++ hardware abstraction, register-map generation, and automated build and regression flows.

Lab Debug : Root-cause complex timing and functional issues in real time using ILA/Vivado Analyzer, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and BER/eye-diagram characterization of high-speed links.

What Makes You a Great Fit

Proven industry experience taking FPGA designs from RTL through timing closure to validated hardware, ideally in an ASIC prototyping, emulation, or high-growth hardware environment.

Expert-level SystemVerilog and/or VHDL for synthesis, with deep proficiency in Xilinx Vivado (synthesis, place & route, timing closure, IP catalog).

Hands-on experience implementing and debugging PCIe, plus AXI/AHB, SPI, UART, JTAG, and other common interfaces.

Strong Python for automation, test, and build tooling.

Strong board-level bring-up and lab debugging skills on real hardware.

Startup mindset: you work independently, pivo

jobs.title: Head of India
jobs.description:
The Role

India is the biggest remittance market with over $130 billion a year flowing home to it, from everywhere: engineers in the Bay Area and Sydney, cabbies in Toronto, construction crews in Dubai, shopkeepers in Leicester, students in Berlin. From Punjabis, Gujaratis, Tamils, Malayalis and Telugus. From people wiring $3,000 a month to a Mumbai mortgage and people sending $80 to a village in Bihar. Your job is to win this market.  You are someone who gets excited by the nuances of the Indian diaspora and how to reach each group, and who wants to own the P&L, the regulatory landscape and pricing at the same time. If you find the price sensitivity of each cohort exciting, and "why do Malayali nurses cluster in specific hospital systems, and what does that mean for acquisition?" as interesting as "what's RBI's latest remittance policy and which banks make the best partners," this is it.  As the GM, you own the P&L, and set pricing. For customer growth, you decide which communities to acquire and in what order. Know the RBI's rules well enough to see the openings inside them, not just the limits. A Gujarati family in New Jersey and a Punjabi trucker in Brampton got abroad through completely different networks, and reaching them takes completely different channels.  Reports to the Head of South Asia. Builds a team of FX Advisors in India and growth managers in sending markets. The face of India inside and outside the company. Total ownership. Be your own CEO

What You'll Own

The P&L. Volume, gross profit and CAC across every India corridor. Not influence, own. A miss is your miss. A beat is your win.

Strategy and sequencing. Which sender markets, which communities, which channels, in what order. US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia and UAE to start. Build the plan, defend it to leadership, execute it.

Pricing. India is the most rate-sensitive, most competitive remittance market in the world, up against competitors who reprice daily. Set FX and fee strategy corridor by corridor.

The regulatory and partner landscape. RBI rules, bank partnerships, payout rails. Know the terrain cold and own the local relationships.

Product. Obsess over UX and the services NRIs actually need. Closer to the customer than anyone in the company, and what you hear feeds straight into product, pricing and customer support.

The diaspora puzzle. Community partnerships, temples and gurdwaras and churches, cricket leagues, student associations, remittance-heavy employers, influencers, festivals (Diwali is a season, not a day). Get in front of each community authentically, and cheaply.

A little about us

incident.io  is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.  The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously. The Role  We're hiring a Product Ops Associate to work closely with our Product Management team.  This role is about is about giving leverage to our product leaders. You’ll pick up a mix of strategic and hands-on work — sometimes shaping big decisions, other times rolling up your sleeves to get the basics right. Both matter. You’ll need to be comfortable with ambiguity, happy to work things out from first principles, and confident context switching often. You’ll get a front-row seat to how we build and scale products — ideal if you want to continue within an operations-esque role or continue to work within some related product role. It’s also great if you want exposure to the scale-up world before choosing where to specialise.

What that looks like day to day

Acting as a right hand to our Product Managers: someone who can be trusted to just figure it out

While you will be working in Product, you’ll be expected to build relationships and get stuff done with leaders across all functions

Breaking down big, messy problems into actionable steps and delivering results

Switching between projects (like figuring out how to extend the reach and stability of our telecom operations) and hands-on work (like supporting our Salesforce application process)

Spotting inefficiencies or gaps and putting systems in place to fix them

Doing the unglamorous work when it matters because sometimes, that’s what’s needed

Who you are

Experience in a fast-paced environment (e.g. startup, consulting, banking, founding experience)

High ownership and bias to action above all else, you get things done

Fast learner with strong analytical thinking

Confident communicator who works well across functions

Comfortable with ambiguity, and quick to bring clarity

Supporting you  We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
A little about us

incident.io  is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.  The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.  We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line  Being a BDR at  incident.io  means learning to sell from some of the best in the business, while representing a product and account team that make every conversation an easy one to be proud of.

What that looks like day to day

Cold calling is the heart of this role, and most of our meetings get booked over the phone - not because it's easy, but because it's still the fastest way to build real trust with a prospect. We don't copy-paste templates, and we don't spam: every call and every piece of outreach is backed by careful research and planning alongside the AEs you partner with, so the person on the other end knows you're not a random dial.  We're founded by engineers, and that shows up in how BDRs work too, everyone gets unlimited Claude tokens, and our head of business development is a former RevOps leader himself, so there's a real emphasis on testing, measuring, and optimizing your own workflow like an engineer would, not just running the same script on repeat.  BDRs are the bench for our wider GTM team, and your progress here matters beyond just you, it's how we keep the whole GTM engine strong. The path to AE is real, and for those who put in the work, that next step can come faster than you'd expect elsewhere - with the strength of the peer group you're learning from making all the difference.  Who you are

You've got a strong why. Whatever got you here - sport, a career switch, a BDR track record that deserved the promotion you didn't get last time, you know exactly what you're chasing, and that's what gets you through the hard days.

Cold calling doesn't scare you. A "no" doesn't ruin your afternoon, it's just the next dial.

You're genuinely curious about people. You want to know what's keeping a VP of Engineering up at night, not just whether they'll take a meeting.

You can write. Not novels, just outreach someone actually wants to open and reply to.

You run toward the hard thing. Given the choice between the easy route and the challenging one, you take the challenging one, because you know that's where the bigger payoff is.

You're always looking for a better way to work, and that includes using AI properly, testing new tools and workflows, not just running the same playbook because it's familiar.

Startup life suits you. Things change, the odd thing is on fire, and you're fine figuring it out as you go with people around to help.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
A little about us

incident.io  is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.  The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.  We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line  Commercial AE is where  incident.io 's growth gets made real - you're in front of the most ambitious digital-native companies out there, and the deals you close show up in the trajectory of the whole business.  What that looks like day to day  This is a full-cycle AE role with a strong outbound bias. Yes, inbound comes in - but the AEs who thrive here are the ones who don't wait for it. You'll own your own pipeline from the ground up, building target lists, running creative outreach campaigns, and picking up the phone without being asked twice. Outbound here is a craft, not a numbers game.  You'll be selling into VP Engineering, CTO, and SRE leaders at some of the most forward-thinking digital-native companies in the world. Deals typically land in the $40k–$50k range with a clear path into six figures, and a sales cycle of around 45 days means you're moving fast and closing regularly.  We run a pod model - you'll work closely with a BDR and Solutions Engineer rather than whoever happens to be free. That means real partnerships, shared context, and accountability that goes both ways. You'll also work alongside CS from early in the deal, which means handoffs that don't lose the thread.  What makes the selling here different is the product and the story behind it.  incident.io  is an AI-native platform built by engineers, for engineers - our founders have been on-call, they've felt the 2am page, and they built something to fix it. When you're in a room with a CTO or an SRE lead, you're not pitching software - you're talking to someone about a problem they've lived, and you understand it. That's the edge.  AEs here are AI-forward in how they operate - whether that's building business cases, running research, or finding smarter ways to work a territory. We expect you to bring ideas, not just execute a playbook.  The progression is real. Commercial AEs have moved into Enterprise and into management - and we'll be straight with you about what the path looks like and what it takes to get there.  Who you are

You've closed deals at a similar size and pace before - $40k–$50k ACV, sub-60-day cycles - and you've got the numbers to back it up.

Outbound doesn't feel like a chore to you. You see it as a craft - you build your own lists, think creatively about how to get in front of the right people, and don't rely on a sequence template to do the work for you.

Everyone loves travelling, but planning is not without its challenges ✈️. That's why we've spent 20 years building tools that turn travel-planning chaos into a breeze. jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.  Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.  Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.  What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.  What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.  If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a  Builder , and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.  We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small  pods , usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a  Stream Lead  who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a  Career Mentor  owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.  We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.  Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately  AI-native  role, and one of the areas where

is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As a Senior Applied AI Engineer on our AI Platform team, you take AI at bunch from working to relied upon. We already run AI in production — a document extraction pipeline live in fund operations, agent workflows on Mastra, evaluations, and multi-provider fallback inside EU data residency. Fund operations run on documents, deadlines and numbers that have to be right — subscription documents to parse, capital calls to chase, portfolio data to reconcile. You build on that foundation: more agents taking that work off people's hands, the evaluations that prove they can be trusted with it, and the platform that lets every other team at bunch ship the same way. This is end-to-end product engineering, not research: you own architecture, evaluation, integration, and deployment.

Top Priorities

Build and ship agents.  Design agents that automate real fund-operations workflows, and own them from prototype through production and after. They integrate with our services, data model, and authorization system — they don't sit beside the product as standalone prototypes.

Evaluate and improve agent performance.  Build the evaluation layer: test cases built from real documents with the output we expect, regression suites in CI, human review where correctness is non-negotiable, and clear success criteria for an agent completing a complex task end to end. Then move the numbers that matter — accuracy, latency, cost.

Own the AI application architecture.  Orchestration and multi-agent design, tool contracts, memory, and context engineering (RAG, MCP) with clear domain boundaries — plus the guardrails, approvals, and human-in-the-loop controls that anything touching investor money requires.

Run it in production.  Versioned, feature-flagged rollout of agent versions; rate limits, provider fallback, and regional failover within EU data residency; and the observability to trace a failure across services and turn it into a fix rather than a theory.

Make it a platform, not a project.  Document parsing and extraction consolidates into this team, and shared evaluation and observability become something other teams consume rather than rebuild. You set the patterns other engineers inherit, partner closely with DevX, and mentor engineers across teams on agent and LLM practice.

Your First 90 Days

Review our MCP offering end to end and ship it to the first customers, with the access boundaries, evaluation and observability a customer-facing surface needs.

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
V7

At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate.  We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini).

The product

V7 Go helps teams turn complex, repeatable work into AI workflows they can run, review and improve .  Built for private markets, insurance and real estate, it supports investment diligence, underwriting, claims review and portfolio reporting—from analysing documents and data to generating deliverables and updating connected systems.  Your experts define how the work should be done. V7 combines reusable Skills, shared company knowledge and configurable workflows, with citations, audit logs and human review to help teams verify results and control key decisions. It supports models including GPT, Claude and Gemini.

Build workflows around your processes.  Configure each stage, choose models and tools, and set review steps where human judgement matters. Teams can inspect sources, correct outputs and refine workflows over time.  Explore workflows .

Give every workflow your firm’s knowledge.  The  Context Graph  connects documents, entities, relationships and source evidence, creating institutional memory that teams and agents can draw on.

Turn analysis into work your team can use.  Generate editable memos, reports, presentations and spreadsheets, and connect workflows to the tools your business already uses.  Explore document generation .

Have a look at what we’re building for  finance  and  insurance .

The team you’ll be joining and the impact you’ll have

You’ll own V7 Go. That’s the whole product, not a corner of it, working with engineers, designers and with the founders close by.

Go 4x-ed revenue last year with 160%+ upsell, and we’re running tens of millions of documents through it for customers in finance, insurance and real estate. What you choose to build next is what decides where that goes.

The product does a lot of different things for a lot of different teams. A big part of the job is having a view on what it should be, and being willing to say no to the rest.

It’s a small product team, so there’s not much process to hide behind. If something’s broken or missing, it’s yours to sort out.

Owning the roadmap. Deciding what gets built, killing the stuff that doesn’t matter, and shipping continuously rather than in quarterly chunks.

Working out which problems are actually worth solving. Sales wants one thing, the loudest customer wants another, and the interesting bet is usually neither.

Defining what good looks like before anything gets built, then checking afterwards whether it landed. Adoption, not shipped tickets.

Making the trade-off calls. What’s in, what’s out, what’s deliberately a bit rubbish for now, and being able to explain why to whoev

jobs.title: Brand Proposition Lead
jobs.description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to  empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places.  Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels.

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.  Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.  We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Brand Proposition Team 👋

Reporting into the Head of Brand Proposition, the Brand Proposition Lead will be responsible for the exploration and development of Trainline's consumer proposition across all markets, ensuring it is delivered successfully and in line with insight and research. This role will have a particular focus on our New Business area, where Trainline is exploring new product verticals and entering new markets, giving you true end to end ownership of shaping a proposition from early insight all the way through to launch.  You'll work closely with teams across the business, including UX Research, Data Science and Brand Insights early on, and Product, UX, Engineering, Country Managers and Creative Studio as propositions move towards execution. This is a highly cross-functional role, and part of what makes it exciting is connecting the dots between different projects so they build into one coherent brand story.

In this role as the Brand Proposition Lead, you will...🚄

Take an insight and data led approach to proposition development, synthesising input from UX Research, Data Science and Brand Insight to build a clear picture of our customer segments

Lead the briefing of new research and insight, working closely with the Head of Brand Insights, and keep a close eye on the external market and competitor landscape to spot opportunities

jobs.description:
About Agent F

Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.  Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.  We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. These founding roles will shape both the product and the way we build it.

About the role

You will be a full-stack engineer, shipping customer features across the interface, application services and database. Your particular strength will be the data and infrastructure that make those features dependable: how records are stored, how imports and background jobs run, and how information moves between Agent F and a customer’s other tools. You will help build and operate the whole product, with deeper ownership of this foundation.  This is hands-on full-stack engineering. A typical piece of work could involve extending a data model, implementing an application service, connecting it to a screen, testing it against a real database and following the release into production. You will also investigate slow reports, failed imports and jobs that stop halfway through, then improve the system so it handles those situations reliably.  That foundation also supports our AI work. As we add document extraction, connected customer knowledge and software that takes actions for customers, you will build the services and data access those features need. Application services and customer features.  Build the logic and application programming interfaces (APIs) that connect records, business rules and screens. Take features through implementation, testing, release and production support.

Reliable background processing.  Build scheduled jobs and workers that process work outside a user request. Handle retries without creating duplicates, resume interrupted runs, and make progress and failures visible to the team.

jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Token Factory is a part of Nebius Cloud, one of the world’s largest GPU clouds, running tens of thousands of GPUs. We are building an inference platform that makes every kind of foundation model — text, vision, audio, and emerging multimodal architectures — fast, reliable, and effortless to deploy at massive scale. To deliver on that promise, we need an engineer who can make the platform behave flawlessly under extreme load and recover gracefully when the unexpected happens.

In this role you will own the reliability, performance, and observability of the entire inference stack. Your day starts with designing and refining telemetry pipelines — metrics, logs, and traces that turn hundreds of terabytes of signal into clear, actionable insight. From there you might tune Kubernetes autoscalers to squeeze more efficiency out of GPUs, craft Terraform modules that bake resilience into every new cluster, or harden our request-routing and retry logic so even transient failures go unnoticed by users. When incidents do arise, you’ll rely on the automation and runbooks you helped create to detect, isolate, and remediate problems in minutes, then drive the post-mortem culture that prevents recurrence. All of this effort points toward a single goal: scaling the platform smoothly while hitting aggressive cost and reliability targets.

Success in the role calls for deep fluency with Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, Terraform, and the craft of infrastructure-as-code. You script comfortably in Python or Bash, understand the nuances of alert design and SLOs for high-throughput APIs, and have spent enough time in production to know how distributed back-ends fail in the real world. Experience shepherding GPU-heavy workloads — whether with vLLM, Triton, Ray, or another accelerator stack — will serve you well, as will a background in MLOps or model-hosting platforms. jobs.title: Fabrication Technician (Cleanroom) (Contract)

About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.

About the role

This is a chance to get hands-on at the heart of a fast-growing AI hardware company. You'll run a micro-fabrication process flow in our London cleanroom, and the samples you make go straight into the prototypes our engineers are building for the next generation of AI infrastructure.  This role suits someone with excellent cleanroom discipline who takes pride in careful, repeatable work and wants to see it make a difference fast.

This is a 3-6 month contract role.

What you'll do

You'll run established process steps from written procedures, working closely with our process engineers

Run cleanroom process steps such as substrate preparation and photolithography, following SOPs exactly

Operate and look after process tools: routine checks, simple maintenance and flagging faults early

Inspect work in progress for defects using metrology tools and decide when to stop and escalate

Take routine measurements, such as thickness, surface profile and feature dimensions, to set methods

Prepare samples for test and hand them over to the engineering team.

Keep accurate run records so every sample is traceable

Keep the cleanroom running: gowning discipline, housekeeping, consumables, materials storage and safe chemical handling

Support engineers on experiments and report clearly what you observed

What you'll bring

Excellent cleanroom practice is the core requirement; we'll train you on our specific tools and recipes

At least one year of hands-on work in a cleanroom (ISO 7 or better), in industry or as a regular research cleanroom user

Practical fabrication experience: demonstrated ability to independently operate fabrication processes and record measurement results using metrology tools

Excellent contamination control: full-gowning, clean handling and working steadily in a cleanroom for long sessions

Careful defect inspection under a microscope, and the judgement to stop and flag a problem

Meticulous record-keeping: you follow SOPs exactly and write down what actually happened

Safe working with chemicals, hot equipment, UV light and lasers

Right to work in the UK, and eligibility under the export-control conditions below

Nice to have

Experience across several process areas, such as coating, bonding, wet processing, deposition or etch

About SkinVision

Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. We are seeking a CMMC Compliance Lead to join Commercial Cyber Operations. This person is the customer-facing lead for CMMC Level 1 and Level 2 engagements and owns NIST SP 800-171 interpretation, scoping, documentation, and assessment readiness from kickoff through the C3PAO assessment and into sustainment. Scope the CMMC assessment boundary: trace FCI and CUI flows, categorize assets per the CMMC Level 2 Scoping Guide (CUI, Security Protection, Contractor Risk Managed, Specialized, Out of Scope), and produce the boundary, data-flow, and network diagrams.

Lead each engagement through the standard delivery process from intake to assessor-ready package, holding the stage gates and evidence standards.

Author and maintain the System Security Plan, policies and procedures, POA&M, and evidence library at the assessment-objective level; score self-assessments and SPRS submissions under the DoD Assessment Methodology and 32 CFR Part 170.

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 조직장 또는 PM으로서 팀을 직접 이끈 경험이 있는 분

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다! (우대요건)

  • 기업 전략기획 부서와 컨설팅에서의 경력을 모두 보유한 분
  • 전사 또는 그룹 차원의 사업계획 및 성과관리 사이클을 운영해본 경험이 있는 분
  • 전사 운영 프로세스 및 제도 설계, 조직 간 R&R 정립 경험이 있는 분
  • Business Fluent 이상의 영어 커뮤니케이션 역량
  • 게임·미디어·엔터테인먼트 산업에 대한 직·간접 경험 및 이해도

크래프톤의 도전에 함께 하기 위해 아래의 전형 과정이 필요합니다.

jobs.title: [AI Frontier Div.] Head of AI Product Dev Chapter Dept. (10년 이상)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

  • AI Frontier 본부는 크래프톤의 AI 기술을 실제 제품과 서비스로 연결하고, 새로운 사업 기회를 검증하고 확장하는 조직입니다. 여러 Squad가 서로 다른 고객과 시장을 대상으로 사업을 추진하며, 각 Squad는 제품 개발부터 서비스 운영과 사업 성과까지 책임집니다. 고객의 요구와 실제 사용 결과를 바탕으로 제품을 개선하고, 사업성이 확인된 서비스를 확장해 나갑니다.
  • AI Product Dev Chapter는 소속 엔지니어들의 기술 역량과 성장을 책임지는 조직입니다. 각 스쿼드의 PO가 제품과 사업을 이끌고, 챕터는 기술 방향·개발 품질·공통 기반·인재 육성을 맡습니다. 스쿼드가 개발·운영하는 제품의 아키텍처와 주요 기술은 챕터에서 결정합니다. 챕터의 목표는 스쿼드의 AI 기술이 고객 가치와 매출로 이어지는 속도를 높이는 것입니다.
  • 스쿼드가 만드는 AI 제품 중 일부는 실제 고객에게 출시해 운영하는 단계에 들어서고 있습니다. 고객 요구에 맞는 기능을 적시에 출시하려면 사업 우선순위에 맞춰 개발 범위와 일정을 정하고, 제품 품질과 운영 비용을 고려해 기술적 병목을 해결해야 합니다. 챕터는 PO와 함께 이 과정을 이끌고, 여러 스쿼드에서 얻은 경험을 본부 공통의 개발 역량으로 발전시켜 갑니다.
  • 이번에 합류하실 분은 챕터장으로서 제품별 기술 의사결정과 공통 개발·검증 체계를 이끌고, 엔지니어를 채용·육성하며 챕터의 일하는 방식을 만들어 갑니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 제품 기술 의사결정: PO와 함께 고객 요구를 기술 과제로 구체화하고, 사업 우선순위에 맞춰 개발 범위와 일정을 조율합니다. 스쿼드별 기술 스택이 파편화되지 않도록 각 제품의 아키텍처와 주요 기술은 챕터에서 결정합니다. PoC가 프로덕션 전환까지 이어지도록 중요한 기술 병목은 직접 설계 검토와 프로토타이핑에 참여해 해결합니다.
  • AI 기술 PoC와 품질 검증: 새로운 모델·API를 빠르게 비교 평가할 수 있는 PoC 환경을 만들고, AI 기능을 실제 사용 시나리오와 데이터로 평가합니다. 실패 사례와 변경 전후의 품질·응답 속도·비용을 비교해 제품 개선으로 연결합니다. 평가는 고객이 비용을 내고 쓸 품질인지까지 확인하고, 결과는 PO가 사업 판단에 쓸 수 있게 정리합니다.
  • AI 기반 개발 생산성: AI 코딩 도구가 코드베이스와 제품의 맥락, 개발 규칙을 이해하고 테스트 작성·배포 설정 같은 반복 작업을 맡을 수 있도록 개발 환경을 갖춥니다. AI가 만든 코드와 설계를 사람이 판단할 리뷰 기준을 세우고, 테스트 자동화로 빠르게 검증할 수 있게 합니다. 새로운 AI 개발 도구는 생산성·품질·보안 기준으로 평가해 도입하고, 구성원이 찾은 좋은 방법은 가이드와 세미나로 스쿼드 전체에 퍼뜨립니다.
  • 공통 개발·운영 기반: 반복 개발 비용을 줄이고 새 기능을 빠르게 출시할 수 있도록 개발 템플릿, CI/CD, 클라우드, 모니터링 등 공통 기반을 만듭니다. 사업 우선순위에 맞춰 적용 범위와 유지보수 담당을 정하고, 쌓이는 기술 부채를 찾아 해결합니다. 제품 출시와 운영을 위해 인프라·보안 등 다양한 부서와 협업해 안정성과 비용 효율을 높입니다.
  • 엔지니어 채용·성장·평가: 사업 계획에 필요한 엔지니어 역량을 정리하고, 이를 검증할 JD·기술 과제·면접 기준을 만들어 채용과 온보딩을 주도합니다. 정기 1on1·멘토링과 테크 토크·코드 리뷰로 구성원의 성장을 돕고 스쿼드 간 기술을 공유합니다. PO와 협력해 실제 기여에 근거한 성과 평가와 경력 개발을 이끕니다.

jobs.description:
ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.

THE ROLE: PRODUCT MANAGER

We’re building a new customer platform, including AI Studio and our machine learning products, largely from scratch. These products need one person who owns what gets built, in what order, and why, and who makes sure what ships solves real problems for teams running AI and ML workloads on our GPU infrastructure. You’ll report to our Chief Product & Technology Officer and lead a team of three Product Engineers, based in London or Australia.

This is a role for someone who’s comfortable shaping loosely defined problems into clear priorities, makes trade-offs and explains them, and takes accountability for adoption and outcomes, not just a delivery plan.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:

  • Own and drive the product vision and roadmap for the new customer platform, AI Studio and ML products, prioritising ruthlessly across customer needs, commercial goals and engineering capacity.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and Security, so products are buildable, supportable, compliant and ready to sell at launch.
  • Run regular discovery with customers and prospects to understand how they build, train, fine-tune and deploy models, and turn what you learn into clear problem statements, user stories and acceptance criteria.

  • Lead your team from idea to release: run the planning and delivery cadence, keep the backlog actionable, and remove blockers along the way.
  • Line-manage and develop three Product Engineers, and help hire and build a team that owns problems end to end.
  • Define and track adoption, activation, usage and retention metrics, and use them, alongside the competitive landscape, to decide what to do next.

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.  Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

Every airframe Harmattan AI flies starts with a model. System identification turns flight data into the verified dynamics that guidance and control are designed, tuned and trained on. It is the foundation of an autopilot that adapts across multirotors, fixed wings, VTOLs and missiles.  As a System Identification Engineer, working out of Paris, you will own the path from flight test to identified model. You will design and run your own experiments, build a repeatable identification pipeline, and deliver models the G&C team can trust.

Responsibilities

Experiment Design & Flight Test: Plan and run your own identification tests, from excitation design to flight tests, including coordinating with the .

Model Identification: Identify rigid-body, aerodynamic, propulsion and actuator dynamics using frequency and time-domain methods, including closed-loop identification on vehicles flown under a controller.

Propulsion & Actuators: Characterize motors, ESCs, propellers and control surfaces, including bandwidth, delays, saturation, and thermal and battery effects.

Identification Pipeline: Build and maintain an automated, reproducible pipeline from flight logs to identified model. This covers ingestion, data-quality checks, estimation, validation and reporting.

Model Validation: Validate models against held-out flight data, quantify uncertainty, and make sure each model is fit for purpose: controller design, simulation, or training learned G&C.

New Airframes: Extend the capability from multirotors to control-surface multirotors, fixed wings, tail-sitters and missiles.

Il investit principalement dans des cibles en changement d’échelle et/ou en développement (tickets d’investissement compris entre 300k€ et 2M€).

Pourquoi nous recrutons

Nous sommes une société de gestion spécialisée dans l’investissement à impact. Nous accompagnons des entreprises qui contribuent aux grandes transitions environnementales et sociales, tout en recherchant une performance financière attractive pour nos investisseurs.

Au fil des années, nous avons construit nos outils et nos processus autour d’Airtable, de différentes solutions SaaS et d’usages ponctuels de l’intelligence artificielle. Cette organisation nous a permis de grandir rapidement.

L’équipe de gestion

jobs.description:
Projet porté par :  Marwa Trabelsi - IMT Mines Albi Centre Génie Industriel (CGI)

Partenaires IMT impliqués :

Telecom Sud Paris, Département Electronique et Physique, Laboratoire Services répartis, Architectures,

Modélisation, Validation, Administration des Réseaux (SAMOVAR): Nel Samama

Mines Saint-Etienne : Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS), Marius Huguet

Sujet proposé (5-6 mois à partir de Février):

Acronyme : HOPAL : Hospital Process Automatic Learning

Titre long : Construction automatique de modèles de processus hospitaliers multi-flux par grands modèles de langage (LLM)

Description du projet :

L’étude du processus de prise en charge aux urgences est essentielle pour comprendre et résoudre le problème croissant de surcharge, qui touche de nombreux pays. Cette surcharge, souvent liée à un déséquilibre entre la demande de soins et les ressources disponibles, a des conséquences graves : retards de traitement, allongement des temps de triage, et même une augmentation de la mortalité. Elle révèle aussi des défis systémiques, comme l’accès difficile aux soins primaires, qui poussent les patients vers les urgences.  Optimiser l’utilisation des ressources humaines et matérielles permet non seulement de réduire les files d’attente, mais aussi d’améliorer la qualité des soins et l’efficacité globale du système. Enfin, analyser ces processus aide à identifier des solutions durables, comme une meilleure organisation ou une réallocation ciblée des moyens.  Ces processus laissent des traces numériques dans le système d'information hospitalier (SIH), mais leur modélisation reste aujourd'hui largement manuelle, coûteuse et rapidement obsolète.  Le process mining permet de découvrir des modèles de processus à partir de ces traces. Les techniques classiques de découverte atteignent toutefois leurs limites face à des logs hétérogènes, bruités et multi-flux.  Les grands modèles de langage (LLM) ouvrent une voie nouvelle : générer automatiquement des modèles de processus (BPMN, graphes de processus) directement à partir de traces organisationnelles, sans intervention humaine, et en produire une lecture compréhensible par les acteurs de terrain.  Par ailleurs, des travaux menés au CGI ont démontré la faisabilité de la prédiction de parcours patients par LLM. La question scientifique au cœur de ce stage est l'articulation de ces deux briques : comment relier la prédiction de parcours à la construction automatique de modèles, pour passer de modèles rétrospectifs (ce qui s'est passé) à des modèles prospectifs (ce qui va se passer) ?  Ce projet s’inscrit dans une dynamique inter-écoles IMT autour de l’IA explicable pour la santé publique. Les équipes CGI, CIS et SAMOVAR collaborent déjà via le projet TRACKING (Carnot M.I.N.E.S – CARINGS), avec des travaux sur la géolocalisation indoor au sein des urgences de l’Hôpital Le Corbusier de Firminy. jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Postdoctoral Researcher Position Deep Learning for Functional-Oxide Growth Video-to-Spectrum Prediction by RHEED / XRD Fusion
jobs.description:
PROJECT OVERVIEW

We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE).

The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon.

A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools.

Scientific context. Epitaxial perovskite-oxide thin films exhibit rich, tunable functional properties (thermoelectricity, ferroelectricity, piezoelectricity) governed by their structure and composition, themselves correlated with the growth conditions. MBE offers independent control of each element but, applied to oxides, is notoriously unstable and poorly reproducible because of the oxidising atmosphere. RHEED tracks the surface dynamics in real time (lattice parameter, surface reconstructions, roughness) but does not give access to the final bulk microstructure, which is only reachable ex situ via XRD / XRR. There is therefore a strong physical link – so far unexploited quantitatively – between RHEED dynamics and final XRD microstructure, which OXYD-IA proposes to learn directly.

Figure 1 – OXYD-IA pipeline. At inference, the RHEED video acquired during growth (INL) feeds a deep video encoder (LIRIS) and a probabilistic regression module that predicts the final XRD spectrum together with its uncertainty. During training, the predicted spectrum is compared with the ex situ XRD / XRR spectrum measured at INL (ground truth); this discrepancy is the supervised learning signal that adjusts the model parameters.

Job Description

The Geometry Scalability team builds the systems that power both Avatars and Environments across Roblox. Our mission is to enable millions of developers to build large, high-fidelity worlds and multiplayer experiences that still run smoothly on phones and low-end devices.

We’re the team that lets Roblox experiences evolve from simple platformers into massively multiplayer, open-world, AAA-quality games. This is a CEO-level priority: how Roblox “ages up” from kids’ games to experiences everyone wants to play, by making higher-fidelity avatars and environments performant at platform scale.

You Will:

  • Design and ship 3D engine systems for avatar and environment geometry, including mesh processing, level of detail, transcoding, streaming, runtime loading, and related performance systems.
  • Partner closely with other teams (Rendering, Avatar, Studio) and external developers so that the features you build are directly usable to create amazing experiences.
  • Profile and improve the performance of our game engine across a wide range of devices, with particular attention to mobile.
  • Lead by example: drive projects end-to-end, mentor other engineers, and help set a high bar for technical quality and code health on the team.

You Have:

  • Proven Expertise: 8+ years of professional experience building and shipping high-performance systems in domains such as game engines, real-time simulation, robotics, AR/VR, or similar.
  • Strong C++ Experience: Deep proficiency in C++, with a focus on writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code in large codebases.
  • Applied 3D Systems Experience: Demonstrated hands-on experience building at least one production system involving real-time 3D rendering, mesh or geometry processing, LOD, animation/skinning, spatial data, 3D

  • Enumerate and reduce attack surface: kernel syscall surface, broker interfaces, device access, and side channels. Assume the code inside is hostile.

  • Systems programming in C, C++, or Rust; comfort at the syscall and kernel-interfac

The Game Engine team is broadly split into departments — Audio-Video-Communication, Avatar, Core AI, Digital Matter, Productivity, and Systems. This position is for the Systems Runtime pod.

We own the runtime layer — the performance, efficiency, and usability of the core primitives that every other engineering team relies on. Think of Runtime as the “standard library” and execution engine for Roblox's C++ world. Our ownership centers on three pillars:

  • Concurrency System — our task scheduler and fiber runtime power how work is parallelized across CPU cores, letting teams scale features across platforms while keeping code understandable and debuggable.
  • Memory System — we own the engine's memory allocator stack, tracking pipelines, and observability tooling to make memory behavior predictable and prevent leaks and fragmentation.
  • Profiling and Observability — we build and evolve the MicroProfiler and telemetry pipelines to help engineers diagnose real-world regressions and keep the client fast at global scale.

This role centers on our Concurrency system. You will own the scheduler and fiber runtime that the rest of the engine is built on, research and implement the performance work needed for 3K-player servers and genre expansion initiatives, and act as the point of contact other engine teams come to with concurrency asks. You will debug real production failures across PC, Mac, mobile, and console, and build deep intuition for how compilers, CPU architectures, and operating systems interact. What You’ll Do:

Join the Roblox Ledger team and build the system of record for a global economy. Our north star is that all movement of value on Roblox is tracked on the Ledger, and that every unit of value — virtual currency, fiat, or digital asset — is accurately tracked, perfectly balanced, and fully auditable. That makes the Ledger the trusted foundation for our users, creators, and economy.

We are the source of truth for the economy in both directions: every write of value, and every read of it. The same authoritative record that settles a transaction also has to answer the questions people ask about it — balances, history, statements, reconciliation, and analytics — so that read paths do not drift from the book of record. Robux already runs entirely on our zero-balanced, double-entry ledger, and Creator Wallets launch in December 2026. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and scale the systems that make this true, in a domain where correctness is the product rather than a feature.

You have

  • A strong understanding of content policy, plus sound judgment on close calls
  • Experience building answer keys, test sets, or calibration materials

Wir suchen kurzfristig einen erfahrenen Finanzbuchhalter

Als eigenständige deutsche Tochter eines weltweiten Musikkonzerns bieten wir individuelle Webshops für Bands oder Künstler an. Auf ihren Touren betreuen wir das Merchandising in Spielstätten in ganz Europa.

In enger Abstimmung mit dem europäischen Management und der globalen Finance-Organisation stellst du sicher, dass Abschlüsse, Reporting, Compliance und interne Kontrollen verlässlich, fristgerecht und nach einheitlichen Standards umgesetzt werden.

  • Zentrale Steuerung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Accounting-Prozesse für das europäische Geschäft von KRM
  • Eigenständige Betreuung der Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung
  • Prüfung von Rechnungen und Abwicklung des Zahlungsverkehrs

  • Identifikation und Umsetzung von Verbesserungen und Automatisierungen innerhalb der Finance-Prozesse
  • Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung und effizienten Nutzung von NetSuite

Profil

  • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise als Steuerfachangestellte:r oder Finanzbuchhalter:in; alternativ eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer eigenverantwortlichen Accounting-Funktion

  • Erfahrung mit Mo
